headline: Two perfect starts, and eighteen days until it counts.
dek: Ouachita Baptist and Rogers State swept the opening weekend — 6–0 and 4–1 on aggregate. The table stays empty until September 17, when Southern Nazarene hosts Harding to open conference play.

validation.policy: observed and derived findings are recomputed against the data home before publish; unverifiable ones are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema, EXCEPT that a checkable basis figure contradicted by the data drops the claim at every label — no chip licenses a wrong number. context is never validated as a finding.
